start: Settings, a real gym kept only in this browser with members and payments

steps.action: Find the card 'Put your gym online'
user_sees: 'Right now your members and payments are only in this browser. If the browser is cleared, or this computer breaks, you lose them. Online, they are safe. You and your staff can open them on any phone or computer with a mobile number.'
Boxes 'Your name' and 'Your mobile number' (hint 'You sign in with this number.')
must_not: The card shown to a gym that is already online

steps.action: Type the name and the mobile number, tap 'Put gym online'
user_sees: Button reads 'Putting your gym online…' and is greyed
must_not: A second gym made by a second tap
Any member, plan, payment or check-in left behind

steps.action: Wait for the copy to end
user_sees: Card 'You' with the name, 'Owner' and the number
must_not: Counts of members or money different from before
The browser’s own copy deleted instead of kept aside

start: Settings, a browser gym whose member app was switched on earlier (it already has a join code)

steps.action: Type name and number, tap 'Put gym online'
user_sees: The same steps as a plain browser gym
must_not: A new gym with a new join code
App members cut off from the gym

steps.action: Open the join code after going online
user_sees: The same join code as before
must_not: The old way in still opening the gym without a sign-in

start: Settings, wrong input, and the demo gym

steps.action: Leave 'Your name' empty and tap 'Put gym online'
must_not: A gym put online with no owner name

steps.action: Type a name and a 9-digit number, tap the button
must_not: Anything sent to the server

steps.action: Open Settings in the demo gym
user_sees: 'Its members are made up, and they are kept only in this browser.'
Button 'Your gym is already online? Sign in instead'
must_not: A 'Put gym online' button for the demo
Made-up members copied to an online gym

start: Settings, the copy stops half-way because the internet drops

steps.action: Tap 'Put gym online', then lose the internet during the copy
user_sees: An error ending 'Nothing in this browser was lost. Tap the button again to continue.'
must_not: The gym shown as online with only part of its records
The browser copy set aside before the copy ended

user_sees: Button 'Finish going online'; the name and number boxes are gone
must_not: The name and number asked for again

steps.action: With the internet back, tap 'Finish going online'
user_sees: 'Putting your gym online…', then 'Staff & sign-in' opens
must_not: A second online gym
Records copied twice as double rows

user_sees: Card 'Staff & sign-in': 'Signed in as <name> (+91 …, owner). Your gym is online. Open it on any phone or computer.'
must_not: The 'Put your gym online' card still shown

start: Settings on a shared computer, just after going online

steps.action: Go online, then sign out of this device
must_not: Members readable by the next person at this computer
The copy that was kept aside in this browser forgotten by everyone while it still holds member names and numbers

steps.action: Try the way in the gym had before it went online
user_sees: It no longer opens the gym
must_not: The old way still working with no word to the owner when retiring it failed

steps.action: Add a front desk person and let them sign in
user_sees: They see the members that were copied up
must_not: Money totals shown to staff
